entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.

2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.304 of 2022, under Section 498A, 306 IPC,
P.S. Qaiserganj, District Bahraich.
3.
In terms of the FIR it was alleged that the daughter of the informant was married to the applicant in the year 2010.

It is argued that the relation between the applicant and the daughter of the informant was not good, as such, because of the harassment at the hands of the applicant, the daughter of the informant committed suicide on 22.08.2022.

entities.text: Gaus Mohammad vs State Of U.P. Thru. The Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Contention of learned counsel for the applicant is that there is no averment with regard to abetment either in the FIR or in the statements so as to attract Section 306 IPC.
He further argues that the informant has turned hostile in the statement given in the trial Court which has been filed alongwith the supplementary affidavit.
5. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

6. Considering the fact that the informant has turned hostile and there is no averment with regard to abetment coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history, the applicant who is in custody since 29.08.2022, is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Gaus Mohammad be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 17.1.2024 nishant  Gaus Mohammad vs State Of U.P. Thru. The Secy. Home on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/44394269/
